mapper.select: select menu_id from sys_role_menu where role_id = #{roleId}
select count(*) from sys_role_menu where menu_id = #{menuId}

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = '0' and m.deleted = '0' and r.status = '1' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != ''
